honest_verdict.principle: complete:/success:/passed:/shipped_ prefix required for conductor reconciler.

inference_substrate.principle: Declares that no LLM was loaded; scoring is over cached candidates. Duration floor is 1s.

k_verifiers.principle: Nominal verifier count; compare to effective_k to quantify redundancy.

lambda_min_sigma.principle: Smallest eigenvalue of the decision covariance; the joint-null-space proxy. Threshold >0.1.
lambda_min_sigma.satisfied_by: numpy.linalg.eigh on the k×k binary decision covariance

pairwise_max_correlation.principle: The exp1224 collapse signature; near-1.0 means structural redundancy.
pairwise_max_correlation.satisfied_by: max off-diagonal |Pearson correlation| over verifier-decision pairs

effective_k_participation_ratio.principle: How many verifiers ACTUALLY contribute independent signal. Threshold >=3.

per_verifier_dropout_contribution.principle: Drop-one-out AUROC delta; ~0 means that verifier is in the joint null space.
per_verifier_dropout_contribution.satisfied_by: remove verifier j, recompute majority-vote AUROC, report full_auroc - reduced_auroc

n_examples.principle: >=1000 for a stable covariance estimate (CLT minimum for stable eigenvalues).

random_seed.principle: Determinism; enables external replication of the exact corpus sample.

reproducibility_checksum.principle: Content hash over first 50 records + seed; detects corpus-version drift.
reproducibility_checksum.satisfied_by: SHA-256[:16] of seed + first-50 step_text prefixes

duration_s.principle: Real wall-clock time; verifier_ensemble substrate floor is 1s.
